title: The Moon's Other Face

mood.label: Uneasy
mood.summary: Ships sank in Hormuz, missiles hit Kyiv homes and North Korea fired from under the sea. Inflation rose, Ebola reached Kenya again and floods hit Istanbul and Santiago. Quieter light: Africa gaining resilience, an answer to the Moon's two faces, a Samoan song making history.

style.genre: cold-wave post-punk — vibraphone, bass guitar, LinnDrum

lines: Cargo goes down in the narrow strait,
Kyiv wakes up to a broken wall.
Something rises from under the sea,
and prices climb before the fall.
A second fever in Nairobi's ward,
Istanbul rain takes a boy away.
the markets flinch and look away.
But the Moon shows why it has two faces,
Africa learns to hold the flood,
and a Samoan love song carries on —
the other face is turning up.
